analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: JPL Horizons heliocentric state at the fixed 2026-09-03 TT scene epoch. The ICRS ring-plane normal is RA 151.03° ± 0.14°, Dec +41.81° ± 0.07°. The body spin axis is assumed to share that normal, as in the published shape fit. The direction of angular momentum is unknown; the positive-declination pole is the paper's arbitrary choice. The photometric period is an approximate spin rate, not a precise sidereal rotational ephemeris. The displayed longitude origin and rotational phase are arbitrary.
provenance.qualification: Computed Chariklo Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
